Name: Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
Summary: Zechariah, son of Jehoiada the priest, stood above the people and warned Judah that because they had forsaken the LORD, He had forsaken them; at the king's command they stoned him in the court of the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Zechariah cried, 'Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper?' and died saying, 'The LORD look upon it, and require it.'
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Joash, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Forgetting a father's kindness can lead a king to murder his friend's son.
